title: cepa amboinensis
intro: Cepa amboinensis, commonly known as the Amboina arum lily, is a species of flowering plant in the family Arum. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties that help relieve congestion and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Cepa amboinensis include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents like alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids. However, further research is needed to confirm the specific bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties.
